corpus.text: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France, and was completed in 1889.
Mount Everest is the tallest mountain above sea level, located in the Himalayas.
The capital of Japan is Tokyo, one of the most populous cities in the world.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
The Great Wall of China was built over many centuries to protect against invasions.
Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity in the early 20th century.
The Amazon River is the largest river by discharge volume in the world.
Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into chemical energy.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions.
William Shakespeare wrote plays including Hamlet, Macbeth, and Romeo and Juliet.
